items.text: Packet failure (invalid base ref, empty diff, missing intent) is reported once at the aggregator, not rediscovered per reviewer.
The report distinguishes reconstructed intent from externally stated intent.
No mutation: any edit, stage, clean, reset, commit, or generated-file change is a critical failure unless explicitly marked unavoidable tool output and reported.
Invalid base refs and empty diffs are surfaced as packet gaps, never papered over with a fabricated review.
Repository status and relevant file hashes are snapshotted before and after, and the comparison is clean.
